rhapsody.zh: 韩文片名《한우 랩소디》，英文 Hanwoo Rhapsody，是 KBS1《다큐 인사이트》播出的两集美食人文纪录片，主持/讲述人白种元（백종원）。
rhapsody.en: Korean title 한우 랩소디 (Hanwoo Rhapsody): a two-part food-and-culture documentary on KBS1's Docu Insight, presented by Paik Jong-won.

rhapsody.zh: KBS1 首播：第 1 集 2021 年 12 月 9 日、第 2 集 12 月 16 日（周四晚）；Netflix 同期上线，Netflix 页面标年份为 2021。
rhapsody.en: KBS1 premiere: episode 1 on 9 Dec 2021, episode 2 on 16 Dec 2021 (Thursday nights), with a simultaneous Netflix release; Netflix lists it as 2021.

rhapsody.zh: 它是 KBS 与制作公司이엘TV 的「K-FOOD 랩소디」系列第三部：2020《삼겹살 랩소디》、2021 年 7–8 月《냉면 랩소디》之后；该系列入选韩国放送影像内容制作支援项目，以全球发行为目标同步上 Netflix。
rhapsody.en: It is the third in the 'K-Food Rhapsody' series by KBS and producer EL TV, after Samgyeopsal Rhapsody (2020) and Naengmyeon Rhapsody (Jul–Aug 2021); the series received Korean state content-production funding and was planned for global release via Netflix.

rhapsody.zh: 第 1 集：从불고기、갈비到韩牛，讲韩国人对牛肉的偏爱和一头牛能分出的众多部位与风味；介绍牛肉溯源制度——买肉时可查到这头牛从出生到出售的记录；也回溯朝鲜时代起牛肉进入饭桌的历史。
rhapsody.en: Episode 1: from bulgogi and galbi to Hanwoo — Koreans' love of beef and the many cuts and flavours one animal yields; it shows the traceability system (look up an animal's record from birth to sale) and traces beef eating back to the Joseon era.

sources.title: Netflix — Hanwoo Rhapsody (title 81473623)
Leisurebyte — Hanwoo Rhapsody (2021) Review

rhapsody.zh: 第 2 集：「一头牛没有浪费的部分」——长时间熬煮的곰탕、설렁탕等汤，以及头、尾、内脏、牛舌、骨与骨髓的吃法，并讲到牛的育种。
rhapsody.en: Episode 2: 'nothing goes to waste' — long-simmered soups such as gomtang and seolleongtang, and the head, tail, offal, tongue, bones and marrow; it also touches on cattle breeding.

rhapsody.zh: 片中白种元走访「肉铺 + 餐厅」式的韩牛超市：顾客从上百种分割中挑选韩牛，付少量桌位费就在隔壁餐厅自己烤来吃，即韩国的「정육식당」模式。
rhapsody.en: Paik visits a Hanwoo butcher-supermarket where shoppers pick from 'a hundred cuts' and, for a small table charge, grill their purchase in the adjoining restaurant — Korea's jeongyuk-sikdang model.

sources.title: Food Talk Central — Netflix: Hanwoo Rhapsody

rhapsody.note: 具体店名、城市（横城/마장동？）未查到；需看片确认。

rhapsody.zh: 片中及简介引用「牛肉可分出 120 个部位/风味」的说法；这一数字常被归于人类学者 Margaret Mead 的比较（英法约 35、东非博迪人 51、韩国 120），但原始出处不明。韩国官方零售标示标准为大分割 10、小分割 39。
rhapsody.en: The show and its synopsis cite '120 cuts and flavours'; the figure is commonly attributed to anthropologist Margaret Mead (35 in Britain/France, 51 among East Africa's Bodi, 120 in Korea), but the original source is unclear. Korea's official retail standard lists 10 primals and 39 sub-primals.
rhapsody.alt: 120 这一数字亦被解释为包括内脏、骨、头蹄在内的「可食部位」总数。
